latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Subtitle Generator

- Generate AI-powered subtitles for YouTube videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB)
- Fast cloud-based processing: most videos returned as 1080p MP4 within 30–90 seconds
- Automatic subtitle syncing, support for English and multi-language workflows
- Simple setup: automatic anonymous token retrieval if needed, no manual API keys required
- Upload, edit, preview, and export workflows supported; all major video and audio formats available
- Includes error handling for token expiry, file issues, and usage limits with clear user feedback
